info.title: strategist_bot control API
info.description: REST control surface of the single-process trading engine: account/position/order inspection and control, risk kill switch, and MT4/MT5 terminal fleet management (subscriptions, ping, batch close).

get.summary: List all configured accounts with supervision state and engine stats.
Get one account's supervision state and engine stats.

post.summary: Queue a single account runner for a fresh broker connection.

get.summary: Current position, top-of-book, and market session per symbol.
Latest bar decisions and broker state for the currently running strategy.
In-process latency histograms for market data and strategy order submission.
Order history for the account; pass open=true for working orders only.

Live aggregated L2 order book for one symbol: best-first levels per
side (prices humanized via the adapter's scale), spread, and the
book's last update time.

post.summary: Flatten the position in a symbol with a marketable limit order at the touch.
Work the position in a symbol toward the requested target lots.

Reconcile engine positions against the broker's open-position snapshot
(clears phantom positions from lost fills or broker-side closes).
Also runs automatically at connect and every venues.positionSyncSeconds.
Cancel one working order by engine order id.
Cancel every working order on the account.

Trip the risk kill switch: all new orders are blocked until reset.
    Journaled: the trip survives account reconnects and bot restarts.
Reset the risk kill switch and resume trading.

get.summary: Configured observe-only monitors and their current feed status.
One-shot live-feed paper state; no broker orders are sent.

post.summary: Starts a simulated pair using explicit assumptions and a server-managed journal.
Stop the paper run and cancel any simulated pending legs.
Acknowledge the displayed simulated positions before replacing a stopped run.

get.summary: Indicative buy-ask/sell-bid comparison; never an execution recommendation.
Local-arrival lead–lag heuristic; not a causal or executable signal.

post.summary:
Manually resync one running venue's catalog (?account=NAME,
    a broker account name or a connected terminal id), or every running
    account and connected terminal when the parameter is omitted.

put.summary:
Supply owned reference data (contract size + quote currency)
    for one catalog row. cTrader's FIX SecurityList carries neither, and
    FIX fill capture excludes unenriched rows (fails closed), so new
    cTrader venues need this once per traded symbol.

get.summary: Configured defaults, journaled overrides, and the effective result.

put.summary:
Edit the engine settings. Only the fields sent change; risk, riskGate,
and strategy replace their whole block. Affected accounts restart on
the reconcile this edit triggers.

delete.summary: Drop every override, reverting to the configured defaults.

get.summary: List connected MT terminals with health and subscriptions.
Fetch current broker positions without waiting for the next heartbeat.

post.summary: Request an immediate heartbeat from a terminal (liveness probe).
Start streaming ticks (or depth with depth=true, MT5 only) for symbols.
Stop streaming ticks (or depth with depth=true) for symbols.
Close a single open position by ticket (full close, opposite deal).
Close every open position on the terminal's account (batch, per-ticket results).

get.summary: All captured venues (secrets masked) with their runner state.

put.summary: Update a cTrader venue (rotate the token, flip live/demo, enable/disable).

delete.summary: Remove a captured venue; its runner stops on the next reconcile.

post.summary: Force an immediate fleet reconcile against the venue tables.

UpdateEngineSettings.description:
One PUT /api/settings edit. Everything is optional — only the fields sent
change; RiskSettings? UpdateEngineSettings.Risk, RiskGateSettings? UpdateEngineSettings.RiskGate, and
StrategySettings? UpdateEngineSettings.Strategy replace their whole block when present.

UpdateInstrumentReferenceRequest.description:
Owned reference data for a catalog row that the venue cannot
    serve itself (cTrader FIX SecurityList has no contract size/currency).
